name: Extertal (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Extertal (a yellow wavy bend and a red star on green and white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 8 October 1970 the municipality of Extertal was granted the right to bear arms, a flag, a banner and an official seal.

features.role: Extertal arms — wavy bend and star
